text:
Alex (CS): FYI customer 'FinServe' says their 30-day trial credits landed on a different workspace than the one their team uses. They have SSO SAML; possible duplicate workspace created during provisioning. :thinking:
Priya (Support): Can you drop the customer_id + the two workspace ids you think are involved? Also any user email that saw the credits in UI.
Alex (CS): customer_id: cust_G4h9s2
Potential active workspace: ws-prod-998 (owner: jane@finserve.com)
Shadow workspace (where credits attached): ws-3456-temp (created via SSO on 2026-02-10)
User who reported: jane@finserve.com
Priya (Support): thanks. Do we have the trial_grant id? I can open a billing ticket once we confirm ownership.
Alex (CS): trial_grant id: grant_2026_03_01_72
Sam (Eng): @Priya @Alex quick question — does the customer sign in via SCIM/auto-provisioning? If scim created a separate org record we may have two org rows with different org_id but same primary_email.
Alex (CS): They use SSO + SCIM provisioning. I can repro by: 1) create new SAML connection 2) trigger provisioning with existing user 3) accept invite. It created ws-3456-temp with different org_id.
Sam (Eng): ok can you paste the raw audit log entry (if available) or the exact timestamp when ws-3456-temp was created? I want to verify linking logic.
Alex (CS): audit log snippet:
```
2026-02-10T14:03:22Z - SCIM - create_workspace - email: jane@finserve.com - workspace_id: ws-3456-temp - org_id: org_9b7c
2026-02-10T14:03:25Z - AUTH - attach_trial_grant - grant_id: grant_2026_03_01_72 - workspace_id: ws-3456-temp
```
Priya (Support): Lina from billing, can you confirm transfer policy? Customer is requesting credits moved to ws-prod-998 and wants no double billing.
Lina (Billing): We can reassign trial credits to another workspace if we verify admin control and no usage consumed in the target workspace. Need: (a) admin email on target workspace (b) screenshot of trial credit seen in shadow workspace (c) consent from customer to move credits. After that we run internal `credit-transfer` job.
Alex (CS): I have admin confirmation from jane@finserve.com and screenshot showing grant attached to ws-3456-temp. They consent to move.
billing-bot: Audit lookup: grant_2026_03_01_72 currently attached to workspace ws-3456-temp (org_9b7c). No tokens consumed under that grant (0 tokens).
Lina (Billing): perfect. @Sam can you run the transfer script with these IDs? I'll create the support ticket and mark as billing-approved.
Sam (Eng): running transfer script now — will snapshot DB and run in dry-run first. Command:
```
./tools/credit-transfer --grant grant_2026_03_01_72 --from ws-3456-temp --to ws-prod-998 --dry-run
```
Sam (Eng): dry-run output:
```
[DRY-RUN] grant=grant_2026_03_01_72 from=ws-3456-temp to=ws-prod-998 tokens=30000 status=ok
checks=passed snapshot=s3://audit-snaps/transfer-1760001234
```
Sam (Eng): executing live now.
Sam (Eng): live output:
```
[OK] transfer started id=tx_88f3
[OK] grant grant_2026_03_01_72 detached from ws-3456-temp
[OK] grant grant_2026_03_01_72 attached to ws-prod-998
```
billing-bot: Transfer complete. tx_88f3. Audit URL: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/tx_88f3
Alex (CS): forwarded confirmation & audit url to jane@finserve.com. She replied: "Thanks — credits now show up on our production workspace. Appreciate the quick fix!" :tada:
Priya (Support): I'll close the support ticket and add a note to ask customers to check for shadow workspaces after SCIM provisioning.
Sam (Eng): Filed an internal issue to tighten SSO->SCIM dedupe logic: ENG-4592. Also added a small migration script to reconcile duplicate orgs by primary email.
Lina (Billing): marking billing ticket resolved. No charge impact.
Alex (CS): closing loop with customer; will follow up in 48h to confirm no surprises. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
